SELECT CASE WHEN p.cnt1 > 1071 THEN p.avg_ext1 ELSE p.avg_net1 END AS bucket1,
       CASE WHEN p.cnt2 > 39161 THEN p.avg_ext2 ELSE p.avg_net2 END AS bucket2,
       CASE WHEN p.cnt3 > 29434 THEN p.avg_ext3 ELSE p.avg_net3 END AS bucket3,
       CASE WHEN p.cnt4 > 6568 THEN p.avg_ext4 ELSE p.avg_net4 END AS bucket4,
       CASE WHEN p.cnt5 > 21216 THEN p.avg_ext5 ELSE p.avg_net5 END AS bucket5
FROM reason
JOIN (
    SELECT
        1 AS reason_key,
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 1 THEN bucket_count END), 0) AS cnt1,
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 2 THEN bucket_count END), 0) AS cnt2,
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 3 THEN bucket_count END), 0) AS cnt3,
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 4 THEN bucket_count END), 0) AS cnt4,
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 5 THEN bucket_count END), 0) AS cnt5,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 1 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS avg_ext1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 2 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS avg_ext2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 3 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS avg_ext3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 4 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS avg_ext4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 5 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS avg_ext5,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 1 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS avg_net1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 2 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS avg_net2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 3 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS avg_net3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 4 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS avg_net4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 5 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS avg_net5
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 1
                WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 2
                WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 3
                WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 4
                WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 5
            END AS bucket_id,
            COUNT(*) AS bucket_count,
            AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
            AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
        FROM store_sales
        WHERE (ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
           OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40)
           OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60)
           OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80)
           OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100)
        GROUP BY bucket_id
    ) AS range_agg
) AS p ON reason.r_reason_sk = p.reason_key
WHERE reason.r_reason_sk = 1
